title: Web Change Intelligence input
description: Fetch a public URL, normalize its content, and compare it against a previous normalized text snapshot or SHA-256 hash.

url.title: URL
url.description: Public http:// or https:// URL to inspect.

previous_text.title: Previous normalized text
previous_text.description: Optional current_text returned by a previous run. When provided, the Actor returns deterministic added/removed excerpts and change metrics.

previous_hash.title: Previous SHA-256 hash
previous_hash.description: Optional current_hash from a previous run. Use this for compact changed/unchanged checks when a detailed diff is not required.

selector.title: CSS selector
selector.description: Optional CSS selector that restricts monitoring to a specific part of an HTML page, such as main, #pricing, or .inventory.

ignore_selectors.title: Ignore CSS selectors
ignore_selectors.description: Optional HTML selectors to remove before comparison, useful for clocks, rotating banners, ads, or other volatile regions.

include_current_text.title: Include normalized current text
include_current_text.description: Return current_text so a later run can perform a detailed text comparison.

max_text_chars.title: Maximum normalized text characters
max_text_chars.description: Maximum characters retained before hashing and comparison. Keep this value consistent across repeated checks.

max_diff_chars.title: Maximum characters per diff excerpt
max_diff_chars.description: Maximum length returned for each added/removed excerpt.

timeout_seconds.title: Fetch timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time allowed for the target request.
